So Far Away From Being Good
Jun 2017 • Couples
Staying at the nearby Novotel Suites, my wife and I ventured down the road to Cowboy Jack's. I have eaten at Cowboy Jack's before and it has been serviceable. Not tonight. It was stinking hot outside and I ordered a pitcher of sangria for myself as my better half does not drink. The waitress proceeded to try and talk me out of the purchase as she recommended it as a "two person drink". She does not obviously know my sordid past!!! After convincing her I could indeed cope with the large serve, the food shenanigans began. Two appetizers, two mains...not so hard one would think. Everything almost arrived together which was entertaining to see the server try to wrangle multiple plates and the aforementioned Sangria pitcher!!!! My wife had ordered a meatball pasta which came out as a sausage pasta, was then taken back as a sausage pasta to be changed to a meatball pasta only to return again as the very same sausage pasta with the confounding explanation that "this is how they do their meatball pasta"...bearing an identical resemblance to the sausage pasta I guess. I got the bacon & cheese hamburger. It was pretty good but had an hysterically small rasher of bacon on it. When asked if there was the possibility of adding some more bacon, I was given an enlightening dissertation on the shrinking properties of bacon when placed upon a hot plate. Food was okay, decor is decent, but don't BS a BS'er guys. No tip left that night.
